Package model

Class StockModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.StockModel
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    IStockModel
    public class StockModel
extends java.lang.Object
implements IStockModel
    The StockModel class represents the "backend" of StocksStimulation. Such that, it contains implemented methods to...
  • Calculate the net profit/loss of a stock over a time period (via the 'calculateChange()' method).
  • The moving average of a stock over a time period (via the 'movingAverage ()' method).
  • The crossovers of a stock over a time period (via the 'findCrossovers()' method).

    • Additionally, the StockModel class has capabilities to...

  • Create (via the 'createPortfolio()' method)
  • Modify (via the 'addStockToPortfolio()' and 'removeStockFromPortfolio()' methods)
  • Calculate the value of a portfolio based on the stocks purchased and the price of the stocks on a given date (via the 'valueOfPortfolio()' method).

      • calculateChange

        public double calculateChange​(java.lang.String symbol,
                              java.time.LocalDate startDate,
                              java.time.LocalDate endDate)
        Calculate the net profit/loss of a stock (termed as 'symbol') from and to a specified date range by referencing stockDatabase. The net profit/loss is: endDate.closingPrice - startDate.closingPrice.
        Specified by:
        calculateChange in interface IStockModel
        Parameters:
        symbol - The stock to examine.
        startDate - The start date to examine.
        endDate - The end date to examine.
        Returns:
        The net profit/loss of a stock over a specified time range.
